scripts.install-all: npm install && cd apps/api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install-all && cd apps/api && npx prisma generate --schema ../../prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "API,WEB,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: cd apps/api && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build && cd ../admin && npm run build
